description: Riehle is leading a project to mobilize disenfranchised voters in CA-04. NAPA, CA – Ray Riehle, the top Republican vote-getter in the CA-04 primary, is crossing party lines to endorse Democrat Eric Jones for Congress and launching a new project to bring disenfranchised voters with him.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Eric Jones for Congress
title: Republican Primary Candidate Crosses Party Lines to Endorse Democrat Eric Jones — Eric Jones for Congress
